title: Google's Pixel 11 introduces Camera Looks, a total rethink of how the camera captures and styles an image, as users seek "more authentic or traditional" photos (David Imel/The Verge)
summary: David Imel / The Verge: Google's Pixel 11 introduces Camera Looks, a total rethink of how the camera captures and styles an image, as users seek “more authentic or traditional” photos — If you look at a photo taken by a smartphone today, it's hard to find much that's technically wrong. Faces are bright and visible.
